account: A team from Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering in India, with Kaythry P among its contacts, pairs a Chronos forecasting model with the Mistral 7B language model. The system gives drivers spoken and on-screen advice on routes, speed, battery use and charging. In its project account, current as of June 2025, the team reports energy-efficiency gains of about 9.2% from driving advice in simulations that compare battery use and travel time. In its sample simulation, a route driven without AI advice drained 27% of the battery over 62 km. A route driven with AI advice drained 19.8% and arrived 5.6% sooner. The team also states that driving feedback improves range by 8 to 12%, and it gives no source for that figure. The system has not been deployed. Its effects on vehicle performance and emissions in practice are unknown. No paper, code release or road test had been reported by October 2026.
